name: 76-absolute-box-sizing
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; } .box { position: absolute; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 5px; border: 3px solid #26384a; color: #fff; } .left { left: 24px; top: 18px; width: 118px; height: 52px; background: #336699; } .right { right: 20px; top: 94px; width: 112px; height: 50px; margin: 4px 6px; background: #7a4f35; } .bottom { left: 42px; bottom: 28px; width: 126px; height: 54px; margin: 8px 4px; background: #476b3f; }
html:
border-box 左定位
right 含外边距
bottom 含外边距
